favourite.heading: Why TCU can pull away
bullets: TCU is the better football team by 4.1 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours TCU by 0.8 points: ball control vs front disruption (-0.8 pts).

underdog.heading: Why UCF can keep it close
bullets: Playing at UCF is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -23.8 to p90 +20.2 for UCF, so a projection of -0.8 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
